messages:
Maya L: Heads-up — new AWQ+FP8 mixed quant on model rwm-13b produced a clear hallucination/regression on the serialize task. Repro + short logs here: https://ci.internal/runs/2412345678 :eyes:
Alex K: On it. Which deployment profile did you use (shared-pool / dedicated / compact)?
Maya L: shared-pool + compact-profile-v2; batch=8; seq=1024. Dataset = serialized config blobs (XML-like with closing tags like </tag>).
Ravi S: Noted. I saw something similar on a CSV task where commas got dropped. Quick bisect pointed at tokenization changes when using AWQ packer.
Chen W: Running the eval now with verbose token decode. Command: ```bash python tools/eval_task.py --model rwm-13b-awq-fp8 --profile compact-v2 --task serialize --seed 42 --verbose-tokens```
Chen W: snippet from output: ``
EXPECTED: <tag>value</tag>
AWQ-FP8: <tag>value
`` — closing tag missing in many samples.
Priya M: Could this be KV-cache boundary or prefix padding interacting with batching? Any evictions in logs?
Maya L: I repro locally with single-request, no eviction. Problem appears at token-level: the sequence that should emit `</tag>` is split oddly.
Alex K: Hypothesis: AWQ packer + FP8 fallback uses a kernel that packs some byte patterns so tokenizer sees different tokenization at decode side, leading to OOV / filler tokens. Can you try GPTQ fallback or force generic kernel?
Ravi S: Quick check: gptq-8bit variant on same eval: accuracy -> 99.2% (was ~85% on AWQ-FP8). So AWQ-FP8 looks broken for this workload.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: rwm-13b-gptq on dedicated pool at 2412345800 for compare runs.
Chen W: I dug into kernel selection: AWQ-FP8 picks our pack-size=64 optimized kernel. If I force SERVE_FORCE_KERNEL=generic the outputs are identical to GPTQ run and closing tags are preserved.
Priya M: Sounds like a kernel/packer mismatch. We should add a deterministic unit test on serialize closing tags and fail the build if delta > 2%.
Maya L: Agreed. Can someone open a quick guard PR to fallback to generic kernel for packsize=64 until packer is fixed? Also add an eval in Redwood Optimize to alert on serialize-task deltas.
Alex K: I'll open PR with a conservative guard + test. Note: generic kernel reduces throughput ~12% for AWQ-FP8, but it's correct. We should document tradeoff in bakeoff notes and default deployments (PLG/shared-pool -> gptq/generic; enterprise/dedicated can opt-in).
Ravi S: After forcing generic kernel locally, accuracy back to baseline. We need to coordinate rollback for any recent auto-rollout that enabled AWQ-FP8 by default in compact-profile-v2.
Maya L: I'll update the bakeoff doc and pin the compact-profile to gptq/generic for now. Thanks all — tagging for follow-ups @Alex K @Chen W @Priya M
